body: [{"streamId":"01a0cf9b-2936-76c7-b214-5811b72b51cf","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a0cf9b-2936-76c7-b214-5811b72b51cf\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022One GitHub review request produces exactly one live pr-review task across every node of the owner\\u0027s fleet, never two\u0022},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:[\u0022Root cause is written into the fix\\u0027s own commit and the card: two daemons of one owner, both with the project registered and auto pr-review on under the same GitHub login, each mint a pr-review task for the same review request within seconds; each node keeps its own ObservedReviewRequest record (id prefixed with its own node id) and the store-level task query in CreateOneAsync sees the peer\\u0027s task only when replication lands, about two minutes later, after both dispatchers have claimed\u0022,\u0022Convergence on replication: when a pr-review task arrives by replication (task_added header originNodeId set) whose external reference already has a live pr-review task in this store, the younger of the two (by UUIDv7 id, deterministic on every node with no coordination) is abandoned as a duplicate before any dispatcher can claim it, with an abandon reason naming the survivor; a run the younger one already owns is killed and retired as superseded, and the same rule applies when the local task is the younger one\u0022,\u0022Hold before mint: a node that observes a review request no task covers yet does not mint on the sweep that first sees it; it records the observation and mints on a later sweep only if, one replication interval later (a node setting with a default near the message-sweep cadence, and zero when the owner has one node), still nothing covers the reference; a request already held past that window mints at once\u0022,\u0022The dedup query in CreateOneAsync and the already-covered fast path treat a replicated live task exactly as a local one, and the ObservedReviewRequest lookup finds the peer\\u0027s record for the same reviewer, repository and number rather than only this node\\u0027s\u0022,\u0022Tests: a two-store test where both stores observe the same review request within the window and replication is replayed between them ends with exactly one live task on both sides and the same survivor on both; a single-node owner minting on the first sweep with no added latency; a replicated younger duplicate arriving after the local one is already claimed is abandoned and its run retired; the existing already-covered fast path test still passes\u0022,\u0022h9k status and the courier feed show the abandoned duplicate once, as a duplicate of the survivor, not as a needs-you row\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Evidence, all from this node\\u0027s store and log (2026-09-24). Three occurrences on arx-platform under auto pr-review mode first: #2140 (2026-09-23): 0222aa22 minted here 18:42:08Z (log: is created), 0ac2114a task_added with originNodeId 01a00d41 (Mac), born 18:42:40Z by UUIDv7, received here 18:44:39Z, claimed here 18:45:22Z. #2143 (2026-09-24): 9233aaaa minted here 15:36:10Z, a3ab84ac from the Mac born 15:36:41Z, received 15:38:04Z, claimed here 15:38:29Z. #2147 (2026-09-24): 5859bfc5 minted here 22:50:17Z, 84e20e28 from the Mac born 22:50:24Z, received 22:52:09Z, claimed here 22:52:32Z, abandoned by hand 22:55:17Z. This node\\u0027s log has exactly three \\u0027is created and reviewing\\u0027 lines, all for the first task of each pair; the later \\u0027already covers it\\u0027 lines alternate between the two tasks because the dedup query orders by AddedAt over two records. mt_doc_observedreviewrequest ids are prefixed with the observing node\\u0027s id, so no node ever reads the other\\u0027s record. Code: src/Hall9k.Daemon/AutoPrReview/AutoPrReviewEngine.cs (DecideAsync near line 439, CreateOneAsync near 688, the existing/previousReview queries), the replication inbox that applies task_added with originNodeId headers, DispatchEngine claim path. Both tasks in each pair were assigned to Brian Hall with no placement, so either node\\u0027s dispatcher claims. Related lesson: dispatched sessions must not run board-mutating h9k commands; the abandon here belongs to the platform, not a session. Prefer the two-layer fix (hold, then converge) over electing one minting node, so a fleet with one node asleep still mints. No em dashes in anything authored.\u0022},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-09-24T23:09:06.3819518\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a04de3-7802-735b-872f-b95015c7216f\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"55a60c18-091f-4cb5-8f6a-ae1b25ba600f","originSequence":42625,"originNodeId":"01a04de3-7a23-75c0-8a06-9314ef6ab27d","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-09-24T23:09:06.396184+00:00","originProjectId":"01a077d8-2b7d-75a0-a0eb-c3deff5f2a4e"}]
